description: Report one heartbeat's uptime over the last N days or a date range, in total and per UTC day, to answer how reliable a job has been. Uptime is the share of time since the heartbeat was created that no incident was open; paused time is left out; a heartbeat that never pinged and had no incident has a null uptime_percentage. Returns heartbeat_id, window_start (the window's first day at 00:00 UTC, or the creation if later; null when the window is older than the plan's history), window_end (the day after its last day at 00:00 UTC, or now), uptime_percentage, downtime_seconds, observed_seconds, incident_count and days (oldest first: date, uptime_percentage, downtime_seconds, observed_seconds; days before the creation are not listed). A range entirely older than the plan's history (get_plan_usage shows history_retention_days) returns window_start null, no days, null uptime_percentage and zero counters. For the outages themselves use list_incidents with heartbeat_id; for the heartbeat's state get_heartbeat; probed monitors use get_uptime_summary.

days.description: How many days to cover, 1 to 1095, ending today; default 30, cut to the plan's history. Not together with from or to.

from.description: First UTC date of a calendar range, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. The range is cut to the plan's history; a range entirely older than it returns no data.

heartbeat_id.description: The heartbeat's uuid from list_heartbeats. An id that is not a heartbeat of this organization, or a deleted one, is a 404.

to.description: Last UTC date of a calendar range, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive; needs from. Without it, or after today, the range ends today.

name: get_heartbeat_uptime

downtime_seconds.description: Seconds of the day an incident of the heartbeat was open while it was not paused.

observed_seconds.description: Seconds of the day the heartbeat existed and was not paused; uptime is measured over this time. Never less than downtime_seconds.

downtime_seconds.description: Seconds an incident of the heartbeat was open in the window while it was not paused.

incident_count.description: Incidents of the heartbeat that were open in the window.

observed_seconds.description: Seconds of the window the heartbeat existed and was not paused; uptime is measured over this time. Never less than downtime_seconds.

window_end.description: End of the window: the day after its last day at 00:00 UTC, or now.

window_start.description: Start of the window: its first day at 00:00 UTC, or the heartbeat's creation if that is later. Equal to window_end, with no days, when the window ended before the creation. Null when the window is older than the plan's history.

title: Get a heartbeat's uptime
